last_funding.notes: Company release dated August 5, 2026 announces access to $20 million in additional equity and debt growth capital.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 25, 2026 platform release notes announce expanded Matrix Pricing support, within the six-month lookback.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation/footer does not show a public pricing page; the site directs prospects to request a demo rather than publishing plans or prices.

employee_band.notes: Crunchbase search profile lists headcount of 51–100.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current Account Executive listing is present on the careers site.

model_provider.notes: Ordway describes AI features and references customer use of assistants such as Claude through MCP, but does not publicly identify the model/provider used for its own AI features in the reviewed product information.

named_customers.notes: Both are named on the company's customer case-studies page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current career listings include Product Manager – AI Finance. The role title explicitly includes AI.

compliance_certs.notes: Ordway says the platform is SOC 1 and SOC 2 audited by an independent accounting firm. The requested set includes SOC 2; no other listed certification is asserted here.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The support integration category and integration page visibly name Salesforce and HubSpot as CRM integrations.

product_one_liner.notes: Product and intended customer categories are stated on the company website.
product_one_liner.value: Ordway provides quote-to-cash billing and revenue automation—including subscription and usage-based billing, accounts receivable, and revenue recognition—for SaaS, cloud, fintech, and other technology-centric businesses.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Ordway announced Mike Miele joined as Vice President of Sales in April 2026.
